description: This Java class 'HttpRequestModifier' provides methods to modify HTTP request components such as path, query parameters, headers, and cookies, including regex-based path modifications.

classes.name: HttpRequestModifier
classes.description: A class for modifying HTTP request components such as path, query parameters, headers, and cookies.

methods.name: requestModifier
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of HttpRequestModifier.

methods.name: withPath (String regex, String substitution)
methods.description: Configures path modification using regex and substitution.

methods.name: withQueryStringParameters (Parameters add, Parameters replace, List<String> remove)
methods.description: Configures query parameters with add, replace, and remove lists.

methods.name: withQueryStringParameters (List<Parameter> add, List<Parameter> replace, List<String> remove)
methods.description: Configures query parameters with lists of Parameter objects.

methods.name: withHeaders (List<Header> add, List<Header> replace, List<String> remove)
methods.description: Configures headers with add, replace, and remove lists.

methods.name: withCookies (List<Cookie> add, List<Cookie> replace, List<String> remove)
methods.description: Configures cookies with add, replace, and remove lists.

methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare HttpRequestModifier instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes and caches the hash code based on path, query parameters, headers, and cookies.
